description: This file defines a React component for a console tab in a trace viewer, including data models, rendering logic, and utility functions for formatting console messages, errors, and ANSI text.

methods.name: useConsoleTabModel
methods.description: Custom React hook that processes trace model data to produce console entries for display, filtering by selected time boundaries.

methods.name: ConsoleTab
methods.description: React functional component rendering the console entries list with formatting, icons, and error/warning indicators.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats console message arguments into React elements, supporting printf-style formatting and ANSI text.

methods.name: formatAnsi
methods.description: Converts ANSI text to HTML and wraps it in React span elements.

methods.name: parseCSSStyle
methods.description: Parses CSS style string into a style object for inline styling.

methods.name: supportProperty
methods.description: Checks if a CSS property is supported for styling.
